title: squarespace.get_contact
description: Input/output contract for retrieving a single contact record. Contacts live on their own base URL and API version: https://api.squarespace.com/v1/contacts (v1), NOT the 1.0 commerce base. Two open questions carried over from connector.yaml: (1) that base already ends in /contacts while the action declares path /contacts, which would double the segment — src/client.ts resolves this by treating the base as the collection root and appending only the id; (2) the v1-vs-1.0 split is itself unconfirmed, since every live call so far returned 401. VERIFICATION STATUS: the LIST envelope in fixtures/contacts.json is real ({ contacts: [], pagination }), but the store had zero contacts, so the single-Contact shape below is modelled from fixtures/contact-by-id.json, itself a placeholder. Confirm before implementing.

input.title: GetContactInput
input.description: UNVERIFIED. Retrieval is by contact id, appended to the contacts collection root.

contactId.description: Contact identifier. Observed ids elsewhere in this API are UUIDs, but no real contact id has been captured, so no format is enforced.

pagination.title: Pagination
pagination.description: Cursor pagination envelope. Verified against fixtures/contacts.json. Unused by this single-record action; retained for the list form documented below.

contactAddress.title: ContactAddress
contactAddress.description: Note this has no firstName/lastName/phone, unlike the commerce Address used on orders.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description: UNVERIFIED — mirrors fixtures/contact-by-id.json, itself a placeholder.

lastModifiedOn.description: Note the contacts API uses `lastModifiedOn` where commerce uses `modifiedOn`.

lists.description: Mailing lists the contact belongs to.

contactListResult.title: ContactListResult
contactListResult.description: NOT the output of this action — documented here because its envelope IS verified against fixtures/contacts.json. Use it if a list_contacts action is added later. Note the array key is `contacts`, unlike orders (`result`).
